attendees.quote: david dorren - vice-chair & clerk, cemetery commission

decisions.decision: The Cemetery Commission recommends that the Select Board pursue American Rescue Plan Act funding for a New England Rustic Field-Stone Wall rather than Hemlock Hedges.
decisions.quote: cemetery commission recommends to the select board members to move forward with securing from the american rescue plan act

decisions.decision: The Cemetery Commission will support the Select Board's request to use the Stabilization Fund at the Fall Town Meeting so more funds are available for ARPA distribution.
decisions.quote: the cemetery commission will support the select board request to use the stabilization fund at this fall's town meeting

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimated replacement cost of Hemlock Hedges, the alternative the presentation does not recommend.
budget_items.quote: replacement cost of hemlock hedges are estimated at approximately $185k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimated cost of the preferred Permanent New England Rustic Field-Stone Wall.
The Ramsden Stone Walls estimate for the free-standing field-stone wall, priced per face foot.
budget_items.quote: new england field-stone wall at $40.00 per face feet.

budget_items.topic: Annual watering cost for replanted hemlocks
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Estimated cost of one year of watering for the newly planted hemlock trees, borne by the Cemetery Commission and DPW.
budget_items.quote: one year of watering will cost the cemetery commission and dpw - estimated at $3k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Additional cost of a well to supply water, excluding pump, piping and electricity.
budget_items.quote: additional cost of $15k or more for a well to be drilled.

budget_items.topic: Funding request for North Cemetery boundary restoration
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission's request for ARPA-related funding for the Restoration of North Cemetery Boundaries.
budget_items.quote: $350k for restoration of north cemetery boundaries.
